records.claim_text: Oldham records 153 underpayments in 2024/25 and says recorded underpayments were rectified through supplementary payment routes; it separately records overpayments requiring recovery action. Error classification was not systematically captured.
records.limitations: No rate or per-head cost. Do not divide by an illustrative transaction count from another period. Management report, not an independent causal evaluation.

records.claim_text: Oldham reports launching a cross-functional payroll reconciliation group and tighter payment approvals; optimisation, training and intended capacity gains remain partly prospective.
records.limitations: Reported actions and plans do not demonstrate net benefit, completed turnaround or reduced errors.

records.locator: Printed p 8, finding M 4; PDF p 10 visually inspected
records.claim_text: The audit records advances of GBP 106,529.57 affecting 142 employees during December 2023–December 2024, linked in the audit to late or incomplete forms and payroll uploads.
records.unit: GBP remedial advances, not administrative cost or loss
records.limitations: Do not sum advances with separate gross overpayments or label either an irrecoverable loss. The GBP 50 charging policy was not being applied and is not an observed unit cost.

records.locator: Printed pp 2–3, sections 1.3 and 2.2; PDF p 5 assurance visually inspected; p 10 M 6 for selected uploads
records.claim_text: The audit gave Reasonable Assurance and praised maintained payroll service after a cyberattack while recording control and capacity issues; selected upload samples had no issues.
records.limitations: Scoped assurance and selected tests do not establish perfect service, uniform accuracy or absence of risk. Positive and adverse findings coexist.

records.claim_text: The audit describes additional authority checking, advances and debtor recovery work around incomplete or late departmental inputs; responsibility for the authorised signatory list does not sit within payroll.
records.limitations: Qualitative rework mechanism. Actual hours and payroll-only administrative cost were not measured here; reported causes do not establish general causality.

records.locator: RTI submission problems and incorrect handling of payroll ID; HTML lines 332–364
records.claim_text: HMRC describes incorrectly handled payroll IDs creating duplicate or wrong employment records, wrong year-to-date information, repeated employer contact, disputed charges and additional manual correction work.
records.limitations: Primary mechanism and guidance, not prevalence or a quantified loss study. Correct payment and correct statutory records are separate outcomes.
